Usage: yantra browser [options] [command]

Manage Yantra-owned browser installations

Options:
  -h, --help              display help for command

Commands:
  install [options]       Download current Chrome for Testing Stable into
                          Yantra-managed storage
  list [options]          List the browsers Yantra can use on this machine, with
                          the current selection. Local only: no network, launch,
                          install, or update check
  use [options] <source>  Select which browser Yantra launches and persist it.
                          Validates the path; never launches a browser or checks
                          for updates
  check [options]         Run a fresh local compatibility check against the
                          selected browser, using isolated synthetic pages. No
                          network: this does not look for a newer browser
  update [options]        Replace the Yantra-managed browser with current Chrome
                          for Testing Stable. This is the only command that
                          checks whether a newer browser exists; use --dry-run
                          to report availability and download nothing
  help [command]          display help for command
